design: ECB Economic Bulletin 5/2026; descriptive euro-area labour-market evidence
finding: Youth weakening is assessed against cooling demand and sectoral composition; exposure alone does not isolate AI.
relevance_and_limit: Strengthens the need for country-by-year controls and industry contrasts; does not validate our ICT estimate as causal.

design: Immiserizing Automation; theoretical working paper with US robot evidence
finding: Junior-task automation may weaken experience-intensive career entry when cost savings are modest; long-run output effects are conditional.
relevance_and_limit: Motivates entry and learning measures. Our employment stocks do not observe skill accumulation or test this mechanism.

design: European Economic Forecast; institutional macroeconomic assessment
finding: Recent youth labour-market weakness is also compatible with ordinary cyclical adjustment; aggregate productivity and employment must be distinguished.
relevance_and_limit: A competing macro explanation, not a causal microstudy or a coefficient benchmark.
